title: W22-2 排序统计加固：化合物级 bootstrap CI、配对 delta_tau_b、留一敏感性、多重比较校正（B1/B2/B3/B4）

resampling.shared_index_matrix_note: one (draws x 49) index matrix is drawn once and reused for every channel and every paired difference, so the per-channel CIs and the paired delta_tau_b share the same resamples
resampling.pair_definition: expand_by_multiplicity: the 49-length resampled vector forms all C(49,2)=1176 index pairs; when one compound is drawn twice its copies are distinct indices and that index pair carries dP0=dRsol=0 (an unresolved tie)
resampling.u_rule: u_i = |leave-one-out residual of the OLS map P0 -> R_sol|, recomputed inside each draw via the closed-form leverage identity
resampling.guard: draws with fewer than 4 distinct compounds are dropped; the surviving count is reported as draws_used

statistics.f_robust_rule: robust / (resolved in both); undefined (NaN) when fewer than 5 pairs are resolved in both
statistics.point_estimate: computed on the original 49 compounds without resampling

paired_delta_tau_b.method: paired bootstrap: the same resampled compounds feed both channels of a comparison, delta_tau_b = tau_b(a) - tau_b(b) per draw

leave_one_out.rule: drop one compound, recompute tau_b on the remaining 48

multiple_comparison.null: shuffle the R_sol compound labels relative to the P0 labels

criteria.ci_reporting: every CI is reported in the same sentence as its point estimate
criteria.delta_tau_b: the paired delta_tau_b 95% CI is the B2 deliverable; a CI that straddles 0 keeps the channel difference at the suggestive level
criteria.multiple_comparison: a channel is labelled survives_correction only if it survives both Bonferroni and Holm
